description: This file defines the 'Language' class within the OpenCart Catalog Controller Event namespace. It manages language variables, including injecting language data into views, backing up language data before controller actions, and restoring language data after controller actions.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class for handling language-related events such as pre- and post-controller execution to manage language variables.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Injects all language variables into the template, populating missing keys with existing language data.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Stores the current language variables as a backup JSON-encoded string prior to controller execution.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Restores language variables from the backup JSON string after controller execution.
